committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects small insured depository institutions holding assets between $3 billion and $6 billion, along with federal banking regulators.
dimensions.evidence: qualifying insured depository institutions with under $6 billion in total assets

dimensions.assessment: Reduces the frequency of routine regulatory examinations from 18 months for certain well-managed institutions, representing an administrative change.
dimensions.evidence: examine qualifying insured depository institutions with under $6 billion in total assets not less than once during each 18-month period

dimensions.assessment: Does not appropriate federal funds or direct large economic shifts, involving minor regulatory administrative costs.
Amends a single threshold in the Federal Deposit Insurance Act regarding bank examination frequency.
dimensions.evidence: Section 10(d) of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (12 U.S.C. 1820(d)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to banking examination thresholds.

missing_information: The exact number of financial institutions newly qualifying under the raised threshold is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies regulatory examination thresholds to permit well-capitalized and well-managed small insured depository institutions with assets under $6 billion to undergo less frequent federal examinations.
